description: Clustered insider open-market purchases: tickers where at least min_insiders distinct insiders made open-market purchases (transaction_code 'P' only) inside the window, with insider count, buy transaction count, total value and latest transaction date. Data filed through 2026-10-22. $0.01 per call — USDC on Solana via x402 (over MCP: call without payment to get the PaymentRequired challenge, then retry with the payment at _meta["x402/payment"]). HTTP equivalent: GET https://exchangerebel.com/toll/insiders/buys.

days.description: Window in days on transaction_date, default 30, cap 365

min_insiders.description: Minimum distinct insiders per cluster, default 2

name: insiders_buys
